defmodule Vault.Ledger.Event do
  use Ash.Resource,
    data_layer: Ash.DataLayer.Ets,
    domain: Vault.Ledger

  ets do
    table :ledger_events
    private? true
  end

  attributes do
    uuid_primary_key :id
    attribute :sequence, :integer, allow_nil?: false
    attribute :account_id, :string, allow_nil?: false
    attribute :version, :integer, allow_nil?: false
    attribute :payload, Vault.Ledger.Payload, allow_nil?: false
    attribute :recorded_at, :utc_datetime_usec, allow_nil?: false
  end

  identities do
    identity :account_version, [:account_id, :version]
    identity :sequence, [:sequence]
  end

  actions do
    read :list

    create :append do
      primary? true
      argument :account_id, :string, allow_nil?: false
      argument :version, :integer, allow_nil?: false
      argument :payload, :map, allow_nil?: false
      argument :recorded_at, :utc_datetime_usec

      change fn changeset, _ ->
        {acc_id, changeset} = Ash.Changeset.fetch_argument(changeset, :account_id)
        {ver, changeset} = Ash.Changeset.fetch_argument(changeset, :version)
        {payload, changeset} = Ash.Changeset.fetch_argument(changeset, :payload)
        
        # payload type validation is automatic through the NewType

        # version constraints
        # need latest version for this account_id
        latest = Ash.Query.new(__MODULE__) |> Ash.Query.filter(account_id == ^acc_id) |> Ash.Query.sort(version: :desc) |> Ash.Query.limit(1) |> Ash.Query.select(:version) |> Ash.read_one!(domain: Vault.Ledger)
        expected = if latest, do: latest.version + 1, else: 1
        if ver < 1 or ver != expected do
          raise Ash.Error.Changes.InvalidAttribute, field: :version, message: "version must be exactly one greater than the current stream version", vars: [expected: expected]
        end

        # global sequence - derived by store
        # use max(sequence)
        last_seq = Ash.Query.new(__MODULE__) |> Ash.Query.sort(sequence: :desc) |> Ash.Query.limit(1) |> Ash.Query.select(:sequence) |> Ash.read_one!(domain: Vault.Ledger)
        seq = if last_seq, do: last_seq.sequence + 1, else: 1

        changeset |> Ash.Changeset.force_change(:sequence, seq) |> Ash.Changeset.change(%{recorded_at: Ash.Changeset.get_argument(changeset, :recorded_at) || DateTime.utc_now()})
      end
    end

    # no update, no destroy
  end

  # Commands exposed on the Event resource
  actions do
    create :open_account do
      argument :account_id, :string, allow_nil?: false
      argument :owner, :string, allow_nil?: false
      argument :opening_balance_cents, :integer, default: 0
      argument :recorded_at, :utc_datetime_usec

      validate fn changeset, _ ->
        {acc_id, _} = Ash.Changeset.fetch_argument(changeset, :account_id)
        {opening, _} = Ash.Changeset.fetch_argument(changeset, :opening_balance_cents)
        if opening < 0, do: raise Ash.Error.Action.InvalidArgument, field: :opening_balance_cents, message: "opening balance must not be negative"
        if exists?(account_id: acc_id), do: raise Ash.Error.Action.InvalidArgument, field: :account_id, message: "account already exists"
        :ok
      end

      change fn changeset, _ ->
        acc_id = Ash.Changeset.get_argument(changeset, :account_id)
        recorded_at = Ash.Changeset.get_argument(changeset, :recorded_at) || DateTime.utc_now()
        
        # append event
        evt = append_one!(acc_id, 1, %{"type" => "account_opened", "owner" => Ash.Changeset.get_argument(changeset, :owner), "opening_balance_cents" => Ash.Changeset.get_argument(changeset, :opening_balance_cents)}, recorded_at)
        
        # snapshot & projection
        state = Vault.Ledger.Fold.initial(acc_id)
        {:ok, state} = Vault.Ledger.Fold.apply_event(state, evt)
        
        # snapshot
        write_snapshot(state, evt.sequence)
        # projection
        update_projection(state, evt.sequence)

        Ash.Changeset.metadata(changeset, :command_result, %Vault.Ledger.CommandResult{command: :open_account, account_id: acc_id, appended: [evt], state: state})
      end
    end

    create :deposit do
      argument :account_id, :string, allow_nil?: false
      argument :amount_cents, :integer, allow_nil?: false
      argument :recorded_at, :utc_datetime_usec

      validate fn changeset, _ ->
        {acc_id, _} = Ash.Changeset.fetch_argument(changeset, :account_id)
        {amount, _} = Ash.Changeset.fetch_argument(changeset, :amount_cents)
        if amount <= 0, do: raise Ash.Error.Action.InvalidArgument, field: :amount_cents, message: "amount must be positive"
        
        # existing state
        state = Vault.Ledger.Aggregate.current!(acc_id)
        if state.status == :absent, do: raise Ash.Error.Action.InvalidArgument, field: :account_id, message: "account does not exist"
        if state.status == :frozen, do: raise Ash.Error.Action.InvalidArgument, field: :account_id, message: "account is frozen"
        :ok
      end

      change fn changeset, _ ->
        acc_id = Ash.Changeset.get_argument(changeset, :account_id)
        amount = Ash.Changeset.get_argument(changeset, :amount_cents)
        recorded_at = Ash.Changeset.get_argument(changeset, :recorded_at) || DateTime.utc_now()
        state = Vault.Ledger.Aggregate.current!(acc_id)
        
        evt = append_one!(acc_id, state.version + 1, %{"type" => "deposited", "amount_cents" => amount}, recorded_at)
        {:ok, state} = Vault.Ledger.Fold.apply_event(state, evt)
        write_snapshot(state, evt.sequence)
        update_projection(state, evt.sequence)
        Ash.Changeset.metadata(changeset, :command_result, %Vault.Ledger.CommandResult{command: :deposit, account_id: acc_id, appended: [evt], state: state})
      end
    end

    create :withdraw do
      argument :account_id, :string, allow_nil?: false
      argument :amount_cents, :integer, allow_nil?: false
      argument :recorded_at, :utc_datetime_usec

      validate fn changeset, _ ->
        {acc_id, _} = Ash.Changeset.fetch_argument(changeset, :account_id)
        {amount, _} = Ash.Changeset.fetch_argument(changeset, :amount_cents)
        if amount <= 0, do: raise Ash.Error.Action.InvalidArgument, field: :amount_cents, message: "amount must be positive"
        
        state = Vault.Ledger.Aggregate.current!(acc_id)
        if state.status == :absent, do: raise Ash.Error.Action.InvalidArgument, field: :account_id, message: "account does not exist"
        if state.status == :frozen, do: raise Ash.Error.Action.InvalidArgument, field: :account_id, message: "account is frozen"
        if state.balance_cents - amount < 0, do: raise Ash.Error.Action.InvalidArgument, field: :amount_cents, message: "insufficient funds"
        :ok
      end

      change fn changeset, _ ->
        acc_id = Ash.Changeset.get_argument(changeset, :account_id)
        amount = Ash.Changeset.get_argument(changeset, :amount_cents)
        recorded_at = Ash.Changeset.get_argument(changeset, :recorded_at) || DateTime.utc_now()
        state = Vault.Ledger.Aggregate.current!(acc_id)
        
        evt = append_one!(acc_id, state.version + 1, %{"type" => "withdrawn", "amount_cents" => amount}, recorded_at)
        {:ok, state} = Vault.Ledger.Fold.apply_event(state, evt)
        write_snapshot(state, evt.sequence)
        update_projection(state, evt.sequence)
        Ash.Changeset.metadata(changeset, :command_result, %Vault.Ledger.CommandResult{command: :withdraw, account_id: acc_id, appended: [evt], state: state})
      end
    end

    create :transfer do
      argument :from_account_id, :string, allow_nil?: false
      argument :to_account_id, :string, allow_nil?: false
      argument :amount_cents, :integer, allow_nil?: false
      argument :recorded_at, :utc_datetime_usec

      validate fn changeset, _ ->
        {from_id, _} = Ash.Changeset.fetch_argument(changeset, :from_account_id)
        {to_id, _} = Ash.Changeset.fetch_argument(changeset, :to_account_id)
        {amount, _} = Ash.Changeset.fetch_argument(changeset, :amount_cents)
        if amount <= 0, do: raise Ash.Error.Action.InvalidArgument, field: :amount_cents, message: "amount must be positive"
        if from_id == to_id, do: raise Ash.Error.Action.InvalidArgument, field: :to_account_id, message: "cannot transfer to the same account"
        
        s_from = Vault.Ledger.Aggregate.current!(from_id)
        if s_from.status == :absent, do: raise Ash.Error.Action.InvalidArgument, field: :from_account_id, message: "account does not exist"
        if s_from.status == :frozen, do: raise Ash.Error.Action.InvalidArgument, field: :from_account_id, message: "account is frozen"
        if s_from.balance_cents - amount < 0, do: raise Ash.Error.Action.InvalidArgument, field: :amount_cents, message: "insufficient funds"

        s_to = Vault.Ledger.Aggregate.current!(to_id)
        if s_to.status == :absent, do: raise Ash.Error.Action.InvalidArgument, field: :to_account_id, message: "account does not exist"
        if s_to.status == :frozen, do: raise Ash.Error.Action.InvalidArgument, field: :to_account_id, message: "account is frozen"
        :ok
      end

      change fn changeset, _ ->
        from_id = Ash.Changeset.get_argument(changeset, :from_account_id)
        to_id = Ash.Changeset.get_argument(changeset, :to_account_id)
        amount = Ash.Changeset.get_argument(changeset, :amount_cents)
        recorded_at = Ash.Changeset.get_argument(changeset, :recorded_at) || DateTime.utc_now()

        s_from = Vault.Ledger.Aggregate.current!(from_id)
        evt1 = append_one!(from_id, s_from.version + 1, %{"type" => "withdrawn", "amount_cents" => amount}, recorded_at)
        {:ok, s_from} = Vault.Ledger.Fold.apply_event(s_from, evt1)
        write_snapshot(s_from, evt1.sequence)
        update_projection(s_from, evt1.sequence)

        s_to = Vault.Ledger.Aggregate.current!(to_id)
        evt2 = append_one!(to_id, s_to.version + 1, %{"type" => "deposited", "amount_cents" => amount}, recorded_at)
        {:ok, s_to} = Vault.Ledger.Fold.apply_event(s_to, evt2)
        write_snapshot(s_to, evt2.sequence)
        update_projection(s_to, evt2.sequence)

        Ash.Changeset.metadata(changeset, :command_result, %Vault.Ledger.CommandResult{command: :transfer, account_id: from_id, appended: [evt1, evt2], state: s_from})
      end
    end

    create :freeze do
      argument :account_id, :string, allow_nil?: false
      argument :reason, :atom, allow_nil?: false
      argument :recorded_at, :utc_datetime_usec

      validate fn changeset, _ ->
        {acc_id, _} = Ash.Changeset.fetch_argument(changeset, :account_id)
        {reason, _} = Ash.Changeset.fetch_argument(changeset, :reason)
        unless reason in [:fraud_review, :chargeback, :court_order], do: raise Ash.Error.Action.InvalidArgument, field: :reason, message: "invalid reason"

        state = Vault.Ledger.Aggregate.current!(acc_id)
        if state.status == :absent, do: raise Ash.Error.Action.InvalidArgument, field: :account_id, message: "account does not exist"
        if state.status != :open, do: raise Ash.Error.Action.InvalidArgument, field: :account_id, message: "account is not open"
        :ok
      end

      change fn changeset, _ ->
        acc_id = Ash.Changeset.get_argument(changeset, :account_id)
        reason = Ash.Changeset.get_argument(changeset, :reason)
        recorded_at = Ash.Changeset.get_argument(changeset, :recorded_at) || DateTime.utc_now()
        state = Vault.Ledger.Aggregate.current!(acc_id)

        evt = append_one!(acc_id, state.version + 1, %{"type" => "frozen", "reason" => reason}, recorded_at)
        {:ok, state} = Vault.Ledger.Fold.apply_event(state, evt)
        write_snapshot(state, evt.sequence)
        update_projection(state, evt.sequence)
        Ash.Changeset.metadata(changeset, :command_result, %Vault.Ledger.CommandResult{command: :freeze, account_id: acc_id, appended: [evt], state: state})
      end
    end

    create :unfreeze do
      argument :account_id, :string, allow_nil?: false
      argument :recorded_at, :utc_datetime_usec

      validate fn changeset, _ ->
        {acc_id, _} = Ash.Changeset.fetch_argument(changeset, :account_id)
        state = Vault.Ledger.Aggregate.current!(acc_id)
        if state.status == :absent, do: raise Ash.Error.Action.InvalidArgument, field: :account_id, message: "account does not exist"
        if state.status != :frozen, do: raise Ash.Error.Action.InvalidArgument, field: :account_id, message: "account is not frozen"
        :ok
      end

      change fn changeset, _ ->
        acc_id = Ash.Changeset.get_argument(changeset, :account_id)
        recorded_at = Ash.Changeset.get_argument(changeset, :recorded_at) || DateTime.utc_now()
        state = Vault.Ledger.Aggregate.current!(acc_id)

        evt = append_one!(acc_id, state.version + 1, %{"type" => "unfrozen"}, recorded_at)
        {:ok, state} = Vault.Ledger.Fold.apply_event(state, evt)
        write_snapshot(state, evt.sequence)
        update_projection(state, evt.sequence)
        Ash.Changeset.metadata(changeset, :command_result, %Vault.Ledger.CommandResult{command: :unfreeze, account_id: acc_id, appended: [evt], state: state})
      end
    end
  end

  defp append_one!(acc_id, ver, payload, recorded_at) do
    Ash.create!(__MODULE__, :append, %{"account_id" => acc_id, "version" => ver, "payload" => payload, "recorded_at" => recorded_at}, domain: Vault.Ledger)
  end

  defp exists?(filter), do: Ash.Query.new(__MODULE__) |> Ash.Query.filter(filter) |> Ash.Query.limit(1) |> Ash.exists?(domain: Vault.Ledger)

  defp write_snapshot(state, seq) do
    if rem(state.version, Vault.Ledger.Snapshot.interval()) == 0 do
      data = Vault.Ledger.Snapshots.dump(state)
      sum = Vault.Ledger.Snapshots.checksum(state)
      Ash.create!(__MODULE__, :create_snapshot, %{"account_id" => state.account_id, "version" => state.version, "sequence" => seq, "state" => data, "checksum" => sum}, domain: Vault.Ledger)
    end
  end

  defp update_projection(state, seq) do
    Ash.upsert!(Ash.create_changeset(Vault.Ledger.AccountProjection, :create, %{"account_id" => state.account_id, "owner" => state.owner, "balance_cents" => state.balance_cents, "status" => state.status, "version" => state.version, "deposit_count" => state.deposit_count, "withdrawal_count" => state.withdrawal_count, "last_event_sequence" => seq, "last_recorded_at" => state.last_recorded_at}), domain: Vault.Ledger)

    events = Ash.Query.new(Vault.Ledger.Event) |> Ash.Query.filter(account_id == ^account_id) |> Ash.Query.sort(version: :asc) |> Ash.read!(domain: Vault.Ledger)
